name: Greenheck EHH-401 wind-driven-rain louver
summary: Horizontal-blade louver family intended for openings exposed to wind-driven rain.
description: Coordinate the rain-resistant frame and sill arrangement with the wall drainage detail. Set out support members without blocking blade passages or access to a screen.
The downloadable GA illustration is independently authored conceptual geometry, with no scale or manufacturer dimensions. Use the official CAD source for the exact layout.
readingNotes: Use the selected EHH-401 submittal for performance and mounting details; a generic louver rectangle does not encode rain resistance.
The product family is distinct from conventional stationary ESD louvers and from EHH-501.
drawingChecklist: Check screen, support and maintenance access.
distinction: The product family is distinct from conventional stationary ESD louvers and from EHH-501.
